name: Boundless Rupture
description: Rupture the ordered qi of a broad field in a boundless burst that races outward from the core.

name: Maelstrom Fang
description: Drive a fang of churning force through guard and flesh and let it spin once inside the foe.

name: Lawless Surge
description: Surge across the field with force that obeys no law and breaks every law-bound technique it meets.

name: Discord Spire
description: Raise a spire of clashing force beneath the target and drive it up through them in one blow.

name: Primal Tumult
description: Loose the first tumult of the world across the front so that nothing in it holds a settled form.

name: Entropic Crown
description: Wear a crown of entropy that eats the order from every technique cast within sight of it.

name: Abyssal Flux
description: Stand in an abyssal flux that nullifies every pattern-bound force trying to take hold of the body.

name: Unbinding Hand
description: Lay a hand on any binding or seal or formation and loose the order that holds it.

name: Primordial Edict
description: Decree the primordial state over the field at a reach and weight that scale with the user's reserve.

name: Pandemonium Crown
description: Raise a crown of pandemonium that wards the user and breaks the field at a measure set by the core.

name: Chaos Throne
description: Take a seat of seething chaos from which each blow and decree lands with a weight that scales with the core.

name: World Unmade
description: Unmake the order of an entire field of battle in one breath to the destructive ceiling of the user's tier.

name: Prelaw Chaos
description: Return the field to the state before law so that for one breath cause and effect in range hold no order at all.
